we develop a provably-efficient distributed joint channel-assignment, routing and scheduling algorithm that can automatically adapt to the network topology and load variations.

our algorithm can achieve the best possible fraction of the maximum throughput, and it is also the most efficient distributed algorithm that can achieve a provably efficient fraction of the maximum network capacity.

the joint channel-assignment, routing, and scheduling problem can be solved efficiently and effectively in a fully distributed fashion.
